literal_meaning: কেতা (পোশাকের ধরন বা পরিমাপ) দুরস্ত (সুসজ্জিত বা পরিপাটি)
figurative_meaning_en: Neat and tidy according to norms or conventions
example_sentences_in_english: He went to the interview all keta dursto.
Everyone looked keta dursto at the ceremony.
note: Refers to traditional Bengali norms of dressing properly and neatly.
